Kairali Ayurvedic Group — Brand Manual, 2026 Edition (rev. 2) 

Brand Manual

2 0 2 6 E D I T I O N

Kairali Ayurvedic Group · supersedes the 2017 guidelines · rev. 2 — Villa Raag joins the family

0 1 · I N T R O D U C T I O N One brand, carried carefully forward

Since 1908, Kairali has practised one thing: health through ayurveda. This manual protects the identity that carries that promise — across our hospital-retreat, products, centres and medicines — and extends it, for the first time, into

a complete digital design system.

A unified and consistent use of these guidelines is one of the key ways we visibly strengthen the equity of our brand.

Please take the time to read and apply them.

What changed in the 2026 edition

Forest green leads action. Deep green \#006038 becomes the interactive color; leaf green remains the identity color.

Full color ramps. Each 2017 anchor now carries a 10-step digital ramp with accessibility guidance.

Red & indigo turn semantic. The tertiary colors now mean error and information — nothing else.

A digital foundation. Spacing, radii, shadows, motion and a full component library now ship with the brand.

Type is consolidated. Kurale + Asap + Lato serve the master brand; sub-brand faces are mapped to licensed- free equivalents.

Voice is written down. The heritage register we have always spoken in is now codified.

Rev. 2 — Villa Raag joins the family. The group's coastal yoga sanctuary on Agonda Beach is recorded as the fifth door, with its endorsement arrangements and type map. Chapters 04, 06 and 11.

0 3 · C O L O R Grown from the logo, tuned for screens

The 2017 anchors are unchanged. Around each, a ten-step ramp now supports digital product work; the values below remain the reference for print.

Leaf

\#8E9D35 · PMS 7495 C45 M20 Y100 K10 Identity, focus, secondary

Forest

\#006038 · PMS 349 C90 M36 Y92 K32 Actions, links, headers

Marigold

\#EEB41E · PMS 7409 C6 M30 Y100 K0 Accent only, never body text

Bronze

\#C1882C · PMS 7510 C23 M47 Y100 K4 Taglines, overlines

Leaf · Forest · Marigold · Bronze · Warm neutrals — steps 50→900. Anchors sit at 500 (Leaf, Forest) and 400 (Marigold, Bronze).

Proportions

Ivory and white carry the composition. Forest works; leaf identifies; marigold punctuates — one accent moment per view.

Heritage red & indigo

\#BE202E now means error; \#26265F means information. They no longer appear decoratively.

0 4 · T Y P O G R A P H Y Three faces, one voice

Kurale — the tagline's face — speaks for the brand in display sizes, always Regular, never bolded. Asap does the everyday work. Lato supports with captions, overlines and numerals. Freefrm721 BT remains reserved for logo

artwork alone.

0 5 · P H O T O G R A P H Y & T E X T U R E Warm, human, real

Professional photography only. Three sanctioned treatments: natural warm color for treatments and places; black & white for portraits and editorial; and the heritage marigold overlay (multiply, reduced opacity) when an image plays

a supporting role.

Natural color — treatments, facility, herbs

Paper and weave textures ground print and hero moments — always subtle. The heritage engraving marks anniversary and provenance storytelling.

Black & white — portraits, editorial

Marigold overlay — supporting backgrounds

0 6 · T H E F A M I L Y O F B R A N D S One family, five doors

Four businesses share the icon and lettering; only the Kurale descriptor changes — bronze on light grounds, marigold on dark. The fifth, Villa Raag, carries its own mark under the group's endorsement: the family's first

endorsed brand.

0 7 · D I G I T A L F O U N D A T I O N S New in 2026: the interface layer

The brand now ships as a coded design system: tokens, webfonts and fifteen interface components. The rules are simple — soft corners, pill actions, warm shadows, calm motion.

Actions

Book a consultation

View treatments

Pill radius · Asap semibold · hover deepens one ramp step — never lifts.

Surfaces

White cards on ivory · 16 px radius · warm-tinted shadow + hairline border.

Rhythm

4 px spacing base · controls 32/40/48 · radii 6/10/16/24 + pill

· content measures 720 px, layouts 1120 px.

Motion & focus

Gentle ease-out fades, 150–400 ms, nothing bounces · leaf- green focus ring on every control.

Components: Button, IconButton, Input, Select, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, Card, Badge, Tag, Tabs, Dialog, Toast, Tooltip, LogoLockup — live specimens in the design-system library.

0 8 · D I G I T A L M E D I A & C H A N N E L S The brand on every screen

Websites, apps, social, email, video and slides all draw from the same tokens. These are the channel rules.

Social media

Avatar: icon on white or ivory circle. Posts: 1:1 and 4:5; stories 9:16. Logo sits in a corner with full clear space, or closes the post as an end frame. One marigold accent per post; photography follows chapter 05. Sub-brand accounts use their own descriptor lockup.

Websites & apps

12-column grid, 1120 px container, 720 px prose measure · header 64 px on ivory with horizontal lockup at 34–40 px · footers on forest-700 or ink with inverted wordmark · chapter 07 components and chapter 10 accessibility rules apply to every screen · KTAHV surfaces additionally follow the clinical register (chapter 11).

Favicon & app icons

The icon alone, centred at 70% of the tile, on forest \#004226 or ivory \#F7F4EA — never the full lockup. Export 16 / 32 / 180 / 512 px. No added effects, borders or gradients.

Email

Single 600 px column on white · lockup at 44 px height in the header · system fallbacks: Georgia for Kurale, Trebuchet MS for Asap · forest links, pill buttons as bulletproof VML/table buttons · signatures: name in Asap semibold, role + contacts in Lato, logo 36 px, no banners.

Motion & video

Logo enters by fade with a settle from 102% to 100%, 400 ms ease-out — never spins, bounces or draws on · lower thirds: forest bar, name in Kurale, role in Asap · captions in Asap ≥ 28 px on 1080p · end card: ivory, centred lockup, tagline · sound and pacing stay calm.

Presentations & share images

16:9 slides: titles in Kurale ≥ 36 px, body in Asap ≥ 24 px, ivory or white grounds, one forest section divider per chapter, icon watermark at ≤ 8% opacity · link/OG images: 1200 × 630, lockup + one Kurale line on ivory or a chapter-05 photograph.

Dark surfaces. Forest-700/800 or ink only. Wordmark inverts to white; descriptors and accents use marigold-300; body text is ivory at 90%. Leaf green is never used for text on dark grounds.

1 0 · A C C E S S I B I L I T Y & P R O D U C T I O N Compliant by default

Digital work targets WCAG 2.2 AA. Print work uses the PMS spot inks for anchors and the CMYK builds in chapter 03.

Color on white Contrast WCAG 2.2 Permitted use

Forest 500 7.7 : 1 AA + AAA Body text, actions, links — unrestricted

Ink on ivory 15.6 : 1 AA + AAA Primary text — unrestricted

Leaf 500 3.0 : 1 Large text / UI Headlines ≥ 24 px, icons, focus rings; body text uses Leaf 700

Bronze 400 3.1 : 1 Large text / UI Overlines ≥ 14 px bold, taglines; body uses Bronze 600

Marigold 400 1.9 : 1 Decorative Never text on white; ink text on marigold passes (8.3 : 1)

Digital standards

Touch targets ≥ 44 px · visible leaf-green focus on every

control · honour prefers-reduced-motion (fades become instant) · form fields always labelled · icons never carry meaning alone.

Print production

Anchors print as PMS spot inks (7495 · 349 · 7409 · 7510) or the

CMYK builds in chapter 03 · ramp steps are screen-first; convert to CMYK per job · 3 mm bleed on all trimmed pieces · logo minimums: 2.5 cm / 1.5 cm.

1 1 · V O I C E A century speaks calmly

Kairali speaks as a family with four generations of practice — warm, precise, unhurried. We say "our" and address "you". We never shout.

We say

"Treatment", not "service" · "Since 1908" — often · Title Case for headings, sentence case for body · botanical names in italic · the tagline always lowercase

We never

Use emoji · exclaim in headings · promise cures · use spa- cliché superlatives · sound clinical or transactional

The Healing Village register (KTAHV) C O M PL I A N C E R U L E

KTAHV is an NABH-accredited Ayurvedic medical facility — a hospital-retreat. Its copy reads clinical and physician-led, never as leisure: patient, physician, treatment, programme, Panchakarma, consultation. Never spa, resort, holiday, getaway, or escape. No

claims of cure — name the conditions addressed and the programmes offered. Specificity over superlatives: years, credentials, named

conditions, real outcomes. Banned filler everywhere: bespoke, curated, discerning, unparalleled, nestled, indulge, pamper, exquisite, world-class, unique.

The coastal register (Villa Raag)

The group's leisure voice — warm, sensory, unhurried. Retreat and sanctuary are sanctioned there; KTAHV's clinical vocabulary is not, and no outcomes are promised. The banned-filler list above applies unchanged. Full register: the Villa Raag brand manual,

chapter 08.

"Health through ayurveda — a promise kept daily since 1908."
